  • Reference

    Replace remove non computable values

    remove_nc.Rd

    Replace remove non computable values

    remove_nc(
  df,
  value = NA,
  remove_rows = FALSE,
  aggressive = FALSE,
  remove_cols = FALSE,
  remove_zero_variance = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    df

    dataframe

    value

    replacement

    remove_rows

    if TRUE it will remove rows with non computable values

    aggressive

    if TRUE it will remove entire row if a single non computable value exists
    if FALSE it will remove row if all values are non computable

    remove_cols

    if TRUE it will remove collumns with non computable values

    remove_zero_variance

    if TRUE it will remove collumns with no variance

    Details

    Non computable values are NA, NAN, inf and empty cells.

    Note

    This function internally replaces non computable values with the value choosen the default value is NA. Then it removes rows and collumns with NA values or zero variance

    Examples

    df<-mtcars
df[1,]<-as.numeric(NaN)
df[2,]<-as.numeric(Inf)
df[3,]<-as.numeric(-Inf)
df[4,]<-as.numeric(NA)
df[5,]<-""
remove_nc(df=df,value=NA)
